# `pca`

the principal components across the members of a stored statistic (members x features), their scores, explained variance and centring.

Version 1, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run pca --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run pca --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run pca --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --of tile_spectra --members tile [--scale unit-variance]
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `x` | statistic any, where {"name": "$of"} | yes |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `of` | `--of` | `required` | - |  | the stored statistic decomposed (two axes: the members and the features) |
| `members` | `--members` | `required` | - |  | the axis whose entries are the members (the observations): its name when unique, or its position from 0 |
| `scale` | `--scale` | `none` | - | none, unit-variance | none = the features keep their units (the covariance's components) \| unit-variance = each divided by its standard deviation (the correlation's) |
| `name` | `--name` | `{x}_pca` | - |  | the stem of the stored statistics: <name>, <name>_scores, <name>_variance, <name>_centring |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| before | [`stats.pca`](../nodes.md) | x=x | members=$members, scale=$scale | components, scores, variance, centring |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

## Outputs

| output | stored as |
|---|---|
| `components` | kind statistic, name $name, of x, axes [{"name": "component"}, {"name": "feature"}] |
| `scores` | kind statistic, name $name_scores, of x, axes [{"name": "member"}, {"name": "component"}] |
| `variance` | kind statistic, name $name_variance, of x, axes [{"name": "component"}, {"name": "quantity"}] |
| `centring` | kind statistic, name $name_centring, of x, axes [{"name": "quantity"}, {"name": "feature"}] |

## Notes from the definition

```text
THE PRINCIPAL COMPONENTS ACROSS THE MEMBERS OF A TABLE (spec docs/specs/2026-11-16-meg-fingerprinting.md, 4.4): a stored statistic of real values with two axes, the MEMBERS (the
observations: the members of a partition, the people) and the FEATURES, decomposed by the thin SVD of the centred table (`nxr::stats`, scikit-learn's PCA; never the features x features
covariance). Every component up to the table's rank is stored, so any k is available; the reconstruction at k is derived at read, never stored.
Stored, as statistics of method `pca`, of the input statistic: `<name>` (principal_components, [component x feature], unit-length loadings, each with its largest loading positive),
`<name>_scores` (principal_scores, [member x component]), `<name>_variance` (explained_variance, [component x 3]: singular value, explained variance S^2/(n-1), its ratio) and
`<name>_centring` (pca_centring, [2 x feature]: the mean removed and the divisor). Precision follows the input's stored precision; the variance table is float64.
It cannot show: a component is a direction of variance in THIS sample; with n members at most n - 1 exist, and the leading ones of a small sample are not stable estimates of a
population's; components are not sources or networks of anything until a separate argument says so.

  nxr-neuro run pca --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --of tile_spectra --members tile [--scale unit-variance]
```
